project: Slag holds the experimental anneal and collet plugins for Claude Code, Codex and Antigravity; Node 22 or later, no dependency installation or build step.
conventions: Root JavaScript uses CommonJS; collet/package.json selects ESM inside collet.
Host discovery files and executable skill resources stay with their plugin.
Public records never name another project except where it was measured.
Tracked text writes zero-width, bidi, tag and stray variation-selector characters as escapes, never raw.
